stdout:
usage: export_plan.py [-h] [--id ID] [--project PROJECT] [--dir DIR]
                      [--output OUTPUT] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                      [--format {markdown,json}] [--no-frontmatter]

Export a plan to JSON or to a Markdown copy

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id ID               Target Plan ID (default: the project's latest active
                        plan)
  --project PROJECT     Project name (default: from the repository)
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current)
  --output OUTPUT       Exact destination file path
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Directory to save the export
  --format {markdown,json}
                        Output format
  --no-frontmatter      Exclude YAML frontmatter from a markdown export
